title: People using cell phones
content: According to the Pew research center, 83 percent of American adults now own cell phones and almost three-quarters send and receive text messages. Cellphone owners between the ages of 18 and 24 exchange an average of 109.5 messages a day --  more than 3200 messages per month.Other research suggests that users check their smart phones about every six and a half minutes, an average of 150 times during a waking day of 16 hours.I like cell phones because they make people sit still, unaware of their surroundings, perfect models for my sketchbook.----Previously on GJ:The Spell of the Cell(2010)Cell Phone Talk(2007)Source:Daily Mail,Edutopia.
